1162:    """Remove common factors from terms in all arguments without
1163:    changing the underlying structure of the expr. No expansion or
1164:    simplification (and no processing of non-commutatives) is performed.
1165:
1166:    Parameters
1167:    ==========
1168:
1169:    radical: bool, optional
1170:        If radical=True then a radical common to all terms will be factored
1171:        out of any Add sub-expressions of the expr.
1172:
1173:    clear : bool, optional
1174:        If clear=False (default) then coefficients will not be separated
1175:        from a single Add if they can be distributed to leave one or more
1176:        terms with integer coefficients.
1177:
1178:    fraction : bool, optional
1179:        If fraction=True (default is False) then a common denominator will be
1180:        constructed for the expression.
1181:
1182:    sign : bool, optional
1183:        If sign=True (default) then even if the only factor in common is a -1,
1184:        it will be factored out of the expression.
1185:
1186:    Examples
1187:    ========
1188:
1189:    >>> from sympy import factor_terms, Symbol
1190:    >>> from sympy.abc import x, y
1191:    >>> factor_terms(x + x*(2 + 4*y)**3)
1192:    x*(8*(2*y + 1)**3 + 1)
1193:    >>> A = Symbol('A', commutative=False)
1194:    >>> factor_terms(x*A + x*A + x*y*A)
1195:    x*(y*A + 2*A)
1196:
1197:    When ``clear`` is False, a rational will only be factored out of an
1198:    Add expression if all terms of the Add have coefficients that are
1199:    fractions:
1200:
1201:    >>> factor_terms(x/2 + 1, clear=False)
1202:    x/2 + 1
1203:    >>> factor_terms(x/2 + 1, clear=True)
1204:    (x + 2)/2
1205:
1206:    If a -1 is all that can be factored out, to *not* factor it out, the
1207:    flag ``sign`` must be False:
1208:
1209:    >>> factor_terms(-x - y)
1210:    -(x + y)
1211:    >>> factor_terms(-x - y, sign=False)
1212:    -x - y
1213:    >>> factor_terms(-2*x - 2*y, sign=False)
1214:    -2*(x + y)
1215:
1216:    See Also
1217:    ========
1218:
1219:    gcd_terms, sympy.polys.polytools.terms_gcd
1220:
1221:    """
1222:    def do(expr):
1223:        from sympy.concrete.summations import Sum
1224:        from sympy.integrals.integrals import Integral
1225:        is_iterable = iterable(expr)
1226:
1227:        if not isinstance(expr, Basic) or expr.is_Atom:
1228:            if is_iterable:
1229:                return type(expr)([do(i) for i in expr])
1230:            return expr
1231:

1233:                is_iterable or not hasattr(expr, 'args_cnc'):
1234:            args = expr.args
1235:            newargs = tuple([do(i) for i in args])
1236:            if newargs == args:
1237:                return expr
1238:            return expr.func(*newargs)
1239:
1240:        if isinstance(expr, (Sum, Integral)):
1241:            return _factor_sum_int(expr,
1242:                radical=radical, clear=clear,
1243:                fraction=fraction, sign=sign)
1244:
1245:        cont, p = expr.as_content_primitive(radical=radical, clear=clear)
1246:        if p.is_Add:
1247:            list_args = [do(a) for a in Add.make_args(p)]
1248:            # get a common negative (if there) which gcd_terms does not remove
1249:            if not any(a.as_coeff_Mul()[0].extract_multiplicatively(-1) is None
1250:                       for a in list_args):
1251:                cont = -cont
1252:                list_args = [-a for a in list_args]
1253:            # watch out for exp(-(x+2)) which gcd_terms will change to exp(-x-2)
1254:            special = {}
1255:            for i, a in enumerate(list_args):
1256:                b, e = a.as_base_exp()
1257:                if e.is_Mul and e != Mul(*e.args):
1258:                    list_args[i] = Dummy()
1259:                    special[list_args[i]] = a
1260:            # rebuild p not worrying about the order which gcd_terms will fix
1261:            p = Add._from_args(list_args)
1262:            p = gcd_terms(p,
1263:                isprimitive=True,
1264:                clear=clear,
1265:                fraction=fraction).xreplace(special)
1266:        elif p.args:
1267:            p = p.func(
1268:                *[do(a) for a in p.args])
1269:        rv = _keep_coeff(cont, p, clear=clear, sign=sign)
1270:        return rv

1280:    and cannot be made commutative. The third value returned is a list

69:    be used as keys, and any terms in the expression containing
70:    other symbols or non-symbols will be returned keyed to the
71:    string 'coeff'. (Passing None for symbols will return the
72:    expression in a dictionary keyed to 'coeff'.)
73:
74:    If ``force=True``, then bases of powers will be separated regardless
75:    of assumptions on the symbols involved.

77:    Notes
78:    =====

81:    separated expressions may not necessarily be grouped together.
